title: ttf-ternary: training ternary language models without master weights
description:
Code for two-timescale threshold flips (TTF): training ternary ({-1, 0, 1}) language models without full-precision master weights, from scratch or from a converted ternary checkpoint. The weights stay packed at 1.6 bits during training; the optimizer state is low-rank (about one byte per weight). Includes the trainer, packed-ternary Triton kernels, pipeline and data parallel training, evaluation and inference code. Since version 0.2.0 the conversion of pretrained models (GPTQ-type ternary rounding, streaming conversion) is a separate package.

The TTF training and inference methods are the subject of UK patent applications GB2623290.0 and GB2624374.1 (patent pending). The code is licensed under the PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0; commercial use needs a separate licence from the author.
